spec.claim_summary: Buy Bitcoin after a 20-day high close beyond the prior marker with at least three bars since the prior marker, exiting within 2-6 bars.
assumptions: Assets mapped from Bitcoin (BTC) on Binance to BTCUSDT spot.
Timeframe 1d taken from page chart, not stated in claim text.
Breakout is close beyond prior 20-bar watermark, encoded as close offset 0 gt highest_high(20) offset 1.
Gap of at least 3 sessions encoded as no breakout on each of the 3 prior bars versus their own prior watermarks.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: claim triggers on both new 20-day highs and new 20-day lows but schema permits only one direction; compiled long-side high-breakout core and omitted low side.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: per-trade structural stop below the latest high/low that triggered the signal cannot be expressed as fixed percent or ATR multiple; no stop used, exit is by time only.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: intrabar stop-entry at the watermark level on the next day; compiled as close-breakout entry with fill at next open per engine rules.
Exit window 2-6 encoded as max_hold_bars 4 with 2-6 swept; no indicator exit given.

evidence.quote: The close of the new high/low must be greater than (beyond) the previous high/low price marker.
the previous high/low marker must have been at least 3 trading sessions prior
the previous high/low marker must have been at least 3 trading sessions prior
the previous high/low marker must have been at least 3 trading sessions prior
Profits/exits should be taken within 2-6 candlestick intervals
OHLCV historical data for Bitcoin (BTC) from Binance exchange.
Buy entry is placed on the next day at the previous 20 day high/low watermark

audit_majors: entry: Claim triggers on both new 20-day highs and new 20-day lows for buys; spec encodes only high-breakout closes (close gt highest_high) and omits all low-side triggers.
stop_loss_pct: Claim requires stops for failed trades placed below the latest high/low that triggered the signal; spec uses null stops and time-only exit, omitting the structural stop.
entry[0]: Claim requires buy entry on the next day at the previous 20-day watermark level; spec triggers on close beyond watermark with fill at next open, different entry level/condition.
